title: Why remote work is dying and nobody wants to admit it

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this — remote work isn’t the future, it’s already failing.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Companies are ditching it faster than you can say “Zoom fatigue.”

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remote work is dying because it’s not working — productivity is down 20% in 2024.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The biggest issue? Collaboration drops when teams aren’t in the same room.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remote work hurts innovation — Google’s 2023 report shows 30% fewer ideas from remote teams.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone — from startups to Fortune 500s — and it’s costing billions.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: So, are you ready to admit remote work isn’t the magic bullet we thought it was?
